dogecoin.text: Nice to see #dogecoin recovering, hope none of you sold in blind panic. I myself did redirect £50 to #gmrfinance for a chuckle. Trading doge has got me interested in #cryptocurrency
Can’t help but think that big corporations are using @dogecoin stock dumps to keep normal people in their place.
@DogeAmillion You know that’s just not possible as there is no hard cap on doge. Even at a few hundred dollars per would mean all the worlds wealth was tied up in dogecoin.
